push.title: W 2-0 vs MidwayMonsters | You: 7.5 (2nd worst match performance)
push.body:
Tough one, BellyTb1. A 7.5 against MidwayMonsters. Be a goldfish about the scoreline and hang onto the lessons.

DID WELL
+ A goal against MidwayMonsters, your 4th straight match scoring. You didn't hesitate, and the keeper didn't stand a chance.
+ Man of the Match, your 3rd for us. That's a captain's performance, armband or not.
+ 1 tackle won earned +0.2. Quiet excellence.
+ 15 completed passes added +0.2. Like interest on savings.
+ 2-0 against MidwayMonsters. A win's a win, and this was a good one.

WORK ON
- 1 goal from 3 on target. Mind this: Pick your spot before the ball arrives, then commit. Changing your mind mid-swing is how shots go wide.
- Rating came in 0.6 below what your on-ball stats earned. Quick fix: Hold your spot in the shape when the ball's on the far side. Drifting leaves the back line naked. Keep it simple, keep it sweet.
- Funny thing: PhogsToffees wrestled with finishing too. Two heads, one fix: square it when the keeper commits.
- 0.6 under your typical rating. Short memory, long season.
- That's your 2nd worst match performance with a 7.5. We go again.

Homework: Timed finishing only when you trust it. A clean shot to the corner beats a mistimed rocket.

BellyTb1, you already know this, but I'll say it anyway: You're not behind; you're just early to your comeback.

We'll get there together. - Coach Lasso

players.name: tuxedo_slide

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: Found the back of the net. Never gets old, does it?

weaknesses.detail: Pass accuracy: 29% (bottom quarter of midfielders is 71% or less)
weaknesses.title: Passing accuracy
tips: Play in triangles - one or two touches, then move. The ball should do the running, not you.
Scan before the ball gets to you - a quick shoulder check means you already know the pass before you need it.
Open your hips to the field when you receive. Side-on body shape turns a back pass into a forward one.
weaknesses.coach: The passing got a little loose out there.

weaknesses.detail: Passes attempted: 14 (bottom quarter of midfielders is 15 or less)
weaknesses.title: On-ball involvement
tips: Show for it. Move into the passing lane and ask for the ball instead of hiding behind your marker.
Give the passer an angle - diagonal to the ball, not flat in a line where it can't reach you.
Move after you pass. A pass-and-move player is always an option.
weaknesses.coach: We didn't see enough of you on the ball. I want you in the thick of it.

weaknesses.detail: Tackle success: 0% (bottom quarter of midfielders is 18% or less)
weaknesses.title: Tackle timing
tips: Press to cut the passing lane, not to lunge at the ball carrier from behind.
Delay, deny, then dictate. Jockey goal-side and only commit when their touch gets heavy.
Every missed tackle leaves a runner free behind you. If you're not sure, contain and let cover arrive.
weaknesses.coach: Diving in a bit too eager. Patience in the tackle.

push.title: W 2-0 vs MidwayMonsters | You: 7.0 (worst match performance)
push.body:
A 7.0 from tuxedo_slide. Tough day at the office. Leave it at the office.

DID WELL
+ A goal against MidwayMonsters. You put it where the keeper ain't. That's the whole trick.
+ That partnership with BellyTb1 is starting to feel like a habit.
+ 1 key pass nudged you up +0.1. Every bit counts.
+ 2-0 over MidwayMonsters. Collective effort, collective win.

WORK ON
- 29% passing (4 of 14, down from your usual 56%). Back to basics: Open your hips to the field when you receive. Side-on body shape turns a back pass into a forward one. You're closer than you think.
- Only 14 passes (down from your usual 18). Little homework: Show for it. Move into the passing lane and ask for the ball instead of hiding behind your marker. Believe.
- Won 0 of 4 tackles. Lesson of the day: Get low and side-on. Square-on defenders get nutmegged. We'll get there together.
- passing accuracy snagged you and PhogsToffees both. Buddy system: give each other short options.
- 1.3 under your usual. That's a dip, not a trend. Promise.

Daily reps: If you're pressed from behind, play it back the way you're facing. Don't turn into trouble.

tuxedo_slide, my granddaddy told me this and now I'm telling you: Fall seven times, stand up eight, then ask for the ball.

Pick one thing from that list and own it next match. Just one. - Coach Lasso
